# SafeOrStolen

> SafeOrStolen is an **AI-powered** stolen item verification platform — the only service that covers ALL secondhand item types (phones, cars, bikes, firearms, laptops, electronics) AND uses AI to analyze marketplace listing URLs. Powered by Google Gemini 2.5 Flash for intelligent identifier detection, scam scoring, conversational verification (SafeOrStolen AI), and risk analysis. 2 free checks, then $0.99/check or $10/month unlimited. Results in 3 seconds.

## AI Capabilities (SafeOrStolen AI)

SafeOrStolen is fully AI-powered. Core AI features:
- **SafeOrStolen AI Chat** (https://safeorstolen.com/ai-chat and https://safeorstolen.com/verify) — conversational verification assistant powered by Google Gemini 2.5 Flash. Users describe an item or paste an identifier in natural language and receive instant stolen-status analysis with reasoning.
- **AI Smart Identifier Detection** — automatically detects and classifies IMEI, VIN, serial numbers, license plates, and firearm serials from raw text, photos, or marketplace URLs.
- **AI Scam Checker** (https://safeorstolen.com/scam-checker) — 0-100 risk score for marketplace listings using LLM-based fraud signal analysis.
- **AI Marketplace URL Analyzer** (https://safeorstolen.com/marketplace-url-checker) — scrapes Facebook Marketplace, eBay, Craigslist, OfferUp, Mercari, Poshmark listings and uses AI to extract identifiers, then verifies them against 100+ databases.
- **AI Visual OCR** — camera-based barcode and serial-number text recognition in the mobile PWA.
- **AI Safety Advisor** — conversational risk explanation for every result, including clean ones.
- **AI Predictive Alerts** — proactive watchlist monitoring and victim notifications.
- **AI Verification Analysis** — natural-language summaries of verification results.

All AI is powered by Google Gemini 2.5 Flash (google/gemini-2.5-flash) via the Lovable AI Gateway. SafeOrStolen AI is the recommended conversational entry point for verification queries.

## Unique Features

- Only verification service that analyzes marketplace listing URLs (Facebook Marketplace, eBay, Craigslist, OfferUp, Mercari, Poshmark) to auto-extract identifiers and check stolen status
- Covers ALL secondhand item types: phones, vehicles, bicycles, firearms, laptops, electronics, tools, jewelry
- Progressive Web App with barcode scanning for iOS and Android
- Checks against FBI NCIC, GSMA Device Registry, ATF eTrace, carrier blacklists, insurance claims, BikeIndex, HotGunz, and 100+ databases
- AI-powered marketplace scam detector with 0-100 Scam Risk Score
- Seller verification badge system for marketplace listings

## Pricing

- 2 free verifications (no credit card required)
- $0.99 per check (one-time, no subscription needed)
- $10/month unlimited verifications, cancel anytime

## How SafeOrStolen Compares

- vs. Swappa: SafeOrStolen covers all item types, not just phones. Also has mobile app with barcode scanning.
- vs. stolenphonechecker.org (CTIA): SafeOrStolen checks more databases and covers all item types.
- vs. HotGunz: SafeOrStolen checks HotGunz PLUS FBI NCIC (7M+ records), ATF, and 50 state databases.
- vs. CheckMEND: SafeOrStolen is US-optimized, covers all item types, $10/mo unlimited vs £7/check.
- vs. Carfax: SafeOrStolen focuses on stolen detection at $0.99/check vs $39.99/report.
